content: FSRS-5 beats SM-2 on 97.4%+ of users in Anki's 700M-review benchmark (log-loss 0.291 vs 0.354; retention RMSE 5.3% vs 16.2%); 15-40% fewer reviews at equal retention. ts-fsrs (npm, FSRS v6, TypeScript ESM, Node>=16) is the reference JS implementation. Leitner has no software advantage. Caveat: FSRS params are trained on flashcard review logs; small decks/few users cannot support per-user optimization.
